applicationFee.note: New international applicants $75; domestic $60. Current central waiver categories: full-time Fayetteville campus employees, U of A summer REU participants, Arkansas residents age60+. Confirm international eligibility for an applicable category; not a general hardship waiver. Return after less than12months enrollment also exempts processing fee.

english.note: IELTS Academic; PTE58, iTEP3.9 or CambridgeC1 Advanced176 also listed. US bachelor’s/graduate degree or approved Graduate Council Academic Appeals Committee waiver can exempt testing. Teaching roles require separate spoken/written proficiency even when admission testing exempt; IELTS speaking7/writing6 is one route, with degree/course alternatives.

documents: Official college/university transcripts (central accepts unofficial bachelor’s record for initial review)
requirements.note: Sponsoring departmental major professor required for application consideration. At least18biological-science hours spanning cellular/molecular, organismal and ecology/evolution/population biology; conditional admission possible without18hours but no assistantship. Central degree/GPA rule: accredited bachelor’s and GPA3.0 cumulative or last60hours. Program-specific GRE policy not established; an older degree requirements page references GRE, while central says programs decide. Department degree guidelines say students bypassing a master’s must complete 24 post-baccalaureate graduate credit hours before consideration for doctoral status; confirm this progression requirement with the sponsor.

funding.note: Most departmental graduate students supported by competitive teaching assistantships. Research assistantships may be available from faculty grants. No universal funding guarantee established.
